note: Fix stale counts (view count, tool count, gap count) and add missing CLI help text.

decisions.question: Should README, IDEAS.md, and docs count strings be updated when the underlying code adds a view or tool?
decisions.commitment: Updated README view table from four to seven (added Signals, Graph, Triage rows). Updated MCP tool count from seven to eight in README, IDEAS.md, and docs/drafts/mcp-resources-prompts.md (nestor_prefs was missing). Updated ui.py docstring from five to seven views. Corrected shoebox gap count in project-layout.md from five open to three open, two closed. Removed duplicate paragraph in README (copy-paste leftover).
decisions.why: Every count string that falls behind the code is a lie the next reader absorbs uncritically. The complexity audit flagged the pattern; these are five more instances of it.

decisions.question: Should CLI arguments without help= text get descriptions?
decisions.commitment: Added help= to domain_args() helper (used by calibrate, decision, and others), match --abs-tol/--pct-tol, import file positional, ledger --limit, and rejections --target-lang/--limit.
decisions.why: A user running --help sees these arguments with no description. The arguments that already had help text (check --abs-tol, ask --source-lang, etc.) prove the convention; these were omissions, not a style choice.
